name: cniska
description: Claude Code plugins for the agent-skills set.

plugins.name: cniska-skills
plugins.description: The agent-skills set, with hooks that start every task on the coordinate routes and gate each commit on a design review.

plugins.name: cniska-record
plugins.description: Keeps the agent-record session record current and tells each session to search it before acting on a handoff or plan.

plugins.name: cniska-worktrees
plugins.description: Tells each session in a project with a worktree setup script to create and remove task worktrees with agent-worktrees.
